conformanceUnits.name: GEN-GeneratorSet
conformanceUnits.description: Support for GeneratorSetType with its mandatory content, and for the enumerations and structures the model is written in.

conformanceUnits.name: GEN-Components
conformanceUnits.description: Support for the engine, the alternator, the alternator phases and the support subsystems: fuel, cooling, lubrication, starting and exhaust aftertreatment.

conformanceUnits.name: GEN-Identification
conformanceUnits.description: Support for the generator-set nameplate beyond the nameplate inherited from OPC 10000-100.

conformanceUnits.name: GEN-StateMachine
conformanceUnits.description: Support for GeneratorStateMachineType, its states and transitions, and the operating modes.

conformanceUnits.name: GEN-Rating
conformanceUnits.description: Support for GeneratorRatingType and for the set of ratings a generator set is certified for.

conformanceUnits.name: GEN-Alarms
conformanceUnits.description: Support for the protection and alarm conditions and their condition state.

conformanceUnits.name: GEN-CANbus
conformanceUnits.description: Support for the CAN bus interface of the engine and for the diagnostic trouble codes it reports.

conformanceUnits.name: GEN-TransferSwitch
conformanceUnits.description: Support for AutomaticTransferSwitchType and its transfer behaviour.

conformanceUnits.name: GEN-Paralleling
conformanceUnits.description: Support for ParallelingControllerType and for the paralleling and load-sharing behaviour.

conformanceUnits.name: GEN-System
conformanceUnits.description: Support for GeneratorSystemType, the aggregate of several generator sets.

profiles.name: Generator Set Server Facet
profiles.description: This Facet defines support for a single generator set: its identification, its operating state and mode, its components and its ratings.

profiles.name: Generator Set Diagnostics Server Facet
profiles.description: This Facet adds the protection and alarm conditions and the CAN bus diagnostic interface to a generator set.

profiles.name: Generator Plant Server Facet
profiles.description: This Facet defines support for a plant of several generator sets: the transfer switches that connect them to a load, the paralleling controller that shares load between them, and the system that aggregates them.
